Important

You can't purchase an eero device from Tangerine on a stand-alone basis or without a compatible Tangerine internet service.

Each Tangerine eero comes with an eero Secure subscription included for 12 months at no additional cost for use with a compatible Tangerine internet service. The initial 12-month subscription commences:


  • if you purchase an eero device with a new compatible Tangerine internet service, on the date that service is first activated; or
  • if you have an existing compatible Tangerine internet service, on the date your eero device is sent to you.

After this promotional period, your eero Secure subscription automatically converts to a paid month-to-month service. You will then be charged monthly in advance at the recommended retail price (RRP) per account (regardless of number of purchased or connected devices) as part of your standard monthly bill until your eero Secure subscription is cancelled. The price of an eero Secure subscription is currently $2.99/mth (inc GST) per account, subject to change on 30 days' notice.


You cannot purchase an eero device from Tangerine without also receiving an eero Secure subscription. However, you can cancel it at any time by contacting us. Cancellation will take effect at the end of your current billing period, as long as it is requested at least 5 days before that date. Otherwise, it will take effect at the end of your next billing period. You can continue to use eero Secure until the date of cancellation.


If you cancel your eero Secure subscription, we will disassociate it from all your eero devices connected to your account and you can continue to use a disassociated device with your compatible Tangerine internet service. However, once this occurs, you cannot reactivate an eero Secure Subscription with Tangerine unless you purchase a new eero devices from us.


Your eero device and eero Secure subscription are subject to the full offer T&Cs, applicable standard terms of service and policies available on the Policies page of our website. By continuing with your eero device purchase you agree to these terms.

>Network Speed and Coverage Information

The mobile product of Tangerine uses the Telstra Wholesale Mobile Network, with predicted coverage areas in all Australian major cities, most outer-metro areas and larger regional centres, as well as many smaller towns and transport corridors. Predicted coverage details are available at https://www.tangerine.com.au/mobile-network-coverage.

Download speeds are capped at 100Mbps on the 150Mbps on the 30GB, 50GB, 75GB & 100GB plans. Download speeds are capped at 250Mbps on the 160GB plan. This is the maximum potential speed. Typical speeds may often be slower and will vary due to factors such as location, device capabilities, distance from the base station, local conditions, concurrent users, hardware and software configuration and download/upload destination

Top Answers

                  
What nbn® plans does Tangerine offer
Tangerine currently offers a range of nbn® plans with various speed tiers, check them out above. Read More
Are there any discounts for new customers
All our nbn® broadband plans come with a new customer discount for the first 6 months, effective from the day your eligible Tangerine nbn® is activated. Please check the terms and conditions for specific details and the applicable discount as it does vary depending on your plan.
Can I bundle my mobile and nbn® plans with Tangerine
You can bundle an active nbn® service and mobile on the one account for a 10% saving on your mobile SIM-only plan. Port your current number across or get a new one. This offer applies to all Tangerine nbn® broadband plans. Check the Terms and Conditions for more details. Read More
What modem options does Tangerine offer
We offer either the pre-configured Netcomm CF40Wi-Fi 6 modem or BYO nbn®-compatible modem options. We also have Amazon eero 6+ routers to pair with your modem for seamless modern smart home integration.
How do I choose the best nbn® plan for my household
Consider your household size, combined Internet usage, and common applications – downloading videos, streaming, gaming, or basic internet use like web surfing, and video calls. Think about your speed requirements (streaming requires faster speeds than web surfing for example), budget, and whether you want future-ready fibre. See our Key Fact Sheet for more information about our nbn® plans. Read More
What is the Fresh Fibre upgrade
The Fresh Fibre upgrade offers eligible customers (those with nbn® Fibre to the Node (FTTN) or Fibre to the Curb (FTTC) connections) a free upgrade to Fibre to the Premises (FTTP) connection when they upgrade to our Speedy nbn® or higher plan. When you order your eligible plan, we’ll arrange for a NBN Co technician to come and install a new Premises Connection Device (PCD) outside your premises and a Network Termination Device (nbn® Connection Box) inside your premises at $0 cost to you. Read More
How can I check if nbn® is available at my address
Enter your address in our nbn® service checker and it will tell you straight away if nbn® is available and also which connection type and speeds you can access at your address. Read More
What are the benefits of choosing Tangerine for nbn® services
We offer no lock-in contracts, unlimited data, free standard connections, flexible plans, competitive pricing, professional support, and discounted starter offers on all our nbn® plans.
How do I sign up for a Tangerine nbn® plan
Check your address to see if you’re eligible, choose your plan, and choose your modem and/or router. The order summary will automatically update as you go. You can either submit the order online, or download and email it through. You’ll receive further instructions from our friendly support team to guide you through any other requirements.

Why Tangerine for nbn® plans?

Simple, reliable connectivity with no lock-in contracts.

 

We’ve been keeping Australians connected since the early days of the nbn®, now powering hundreds of thousands of households nationwide. Pretty sweet, right!

 

We’re an authorised nbn® Retail Service Provider (RSP), delivering services via Aussie Broadband’s trusted network, so you get strong, reliable performance without the fuss.

 

We provide nbn® services nationwide, wherever Fibre to the Premises (FTTP), Fibre to the Curb (FTTC), Fibre to the Node (FTTN), Hybrid Fibre Coaxial (HFC) and Fixed Wireless are available.

 

Tangerine offers nbn® ready Wi-Fi 7 Routers, compatible with all connection types, including FTTP, FTTC, FTTN, HFC and Fixed Wireless. You can choose from our hardware options or bring your own compatible device (BYO Wi-Fi Router), helping reduce waste and giving you flexibility. Please be sure to check the BYO modem requirements  before purchasing a device or signing up.

 

So, what are you waiting for? Switch to a refreshingly simple nbn® plan, simple, reliable and seriously sweet.

 

What Next?

Now that you’ve found Tangerine’s nbn® home internet plans, you can order your service via our online sign-up tool. Explore our nbn® plans with a variety of speed options and select a plan that suits your needs, with perks like unlimited data and no lock-in contracts.

 

Your first month nbn® plan fees are charged at sign-up, plus any additional Wi-Fi Routers purchased during your sign-up journey.

 

We accept VISA, Mastercard or AMEX. Once your payment is complete, we will get straight to work and submit your order to nbn®. If nbn® has not been connected at the property before, it will typically take between 1 and 3 weeks to secure the next installation appointment to activate nbn® at your address. See our article ‘ How Long Does It Take to Get Connected to the nbn® ’ for more information on installation time frames.

 

We will keep you up to date on every step of the process to activate your nbn® connection.

If access to your property is required, we will let you know. It is important that someone is available to provide access during the scheduled activation appointment. If the timing doesn’t suit, just let us know and we can re-schedule this for you.

 

If you have purchased an nbn® ready Wi-Fi Router, this will be shipped prior to your appointment so that it is ready to go as soon as nbn® completes the activation.

 

Our technical support team is available 7 days a week to assist you should you ever require assistance getting online.
